notes: Just Ask! by Sonia Sotomayor features a diverse group of children with various disabilities (autism, ADHD, hearing loss, mobility differences, visual impairment, diabetes, dyslexia, selective mutism) who each contribute to a community garden. The existing activity_images set (garden, seed, wheelchair, glasses, hearing_aid, rake, flower, pot, bee, tomato, watering_can, shovel) is an excellent match for this book. The fringe selection prioritises the book's central themes: disability inclusion (wheelchair, glasses, hearing_aid), the garden setting (garden, seed, flower, plant), and the social-emotional core (ask, different, friend, together). Note that 'different' appears in both core row 2 and fringe — if the board tool flags duplicates, substitute 'disability' or 'brave' (from the book subtitle) for the fringe slot. 'Ask' is the title concept and critically important for AAC users as a meta-communication word.
